source_cells_and_family_schemas.literal_member_binding: A selector identifies the source equilibrium record and every admissible internal belief-function parameter of that record; coordinates cannot be spliced.

none_reason.certificate: Interior type imitation forces a common payoff u>=d_1>p_0; then every on-path posterior must exceed nu_star, contradicting Bayes plausibility at nu<=nu_star.

family_records.member_parameter_or_selector: A Borel probability sigma_1 over the zero-prior type's best-response set; sigma_0 is degenerate at q_0; kappa_U selects literal low-cell C_U members.

member_generator.sigma_1_if_Delta_zero: any Borel probability supported on {q_0} union R_0, R_0={s:min_j x_j<w_0}
member_generator.sigma_1_if_Delta_negative: any Borel probability supported on R_0
member_generator.belief: mu(s)=0 for every s in Y
member_generator.continuation: kappa_U(r) is a complete N4-SC-EQ-L-STAR member for every rejected history r

family_records.necessary_and_sufficient_membership_rule: The displayed support rule is necessary and sufficient: q_0 uniquely maximizes the low type's payoff; the zero-prior high type maximizes max{p_0,d_1} under the support-restricted belief zero.

strategy_by_type.theta_1: sigma_1 as generated by the sign of Delta

family_records.weak_vote_strategy: For every proposal and every weak identity j, vote yes iff x_j>=w_0; at equality T^Y selects yes.

belief_system.proposal: posterior identically zero, including proposals used only by the zero-prior type

payoff_by_type_and_identity.weak_identity_j: For theta_0, x_j=w_0 at immediate q_0 agreement. For the zero-prior theta_1, integrate x_j on accepted proposals and w_0 on rejected proposals under the same sigma_1 binder.

outcome_distribution.theta_0: immediate unanimous agreement at q_0 with probability one
outcome_distribution.theta_1: immediate agreement if q_0 is drawn and rejection followed by the literal low-cell continuation if R_0 is drawn
outcome_distribution.ex_ante: immediate unanimous agreement at q_0 with probability one because nu=0
